chunking.equation_detection: display math blocks and standalone mathematical expressions
chunking.strategy: section bounded paragraph groups, grouped atomic table rows, contextual captions, dedicated equations with captions or surrounding context, page context for uncaptioned images, and visually extracted model and formal diagrams

diagram_extraction.acceptance_rule: status is ok and contains_target_diagram is true
diagram_extraction.candidate_rule: matching model or formal diagram caption evidence, BIP report context, captioned images in Simulink sections, plus images from reports whose title names a target language or formalism
